condition.title: Condition
condition.p: The conditon is that the internet is not working.

ol.li: Too many users are logged on to the internet.
This issue can also arise when the distance from the server is high.

step.cmd: Enter the name of the country in the search bar.
step.stepxmp: For example, the user enters the name of country as Japan.

step.cmd: Click the Upgrade button on the resulting screen.
step.stepresult: You will see a webpage with options for 3 payment plans for 1 month, 12 months and 24 months

step.cmd: Click on Upgradebelow these options to choose a plan.
